next.reason: 1985: 'Format 1 must be used for all files in sequential access mode.' 2023 §2023:14.9.30.3 SR8: with ACCESS MODE SEQUENTIAL and neither NEXT nor PREVIOUS, 'the NEXT phrase is implied'; §2023:14.9.30.4 GR19: an implicit or explicit NEXT 'results in a sequential read', i.e. format 1 (§2023:14.9.30.2 'Format 1 (sequential)'), so format-2 phrases (KEY, INVALID KEY) remain unavailable for a sequential-access file. PREVIOUS is a new phrase within format 1. Same requirement.
